purpose: P-TABLE flow coverage manifest (period x session x data type). Committed pre-build as part of the holdout declaration.
data_object_note: All families are 1-minute-sampled MBP-10 book snapshots (~1 row/min, 3 action=T rows across 510 files). No trade prints, no aggressor side: delta / CVD / footprint are NOT computable from this archive. Book features (walls, imbalance, spread, censoring) are computable at 1-minute resolution; sub-minute book events are invisible.

ohlcv.overlap_dedup: 2025-01-01..2025-02-28 present in two files; dedupe on (ts_event, symbol)
ohlcv.symbology: all NQ outrights + calendar spreads; front month = max daily volume among outrights

A.window_desc: 08:00-10:29 America/New_York (NY warm-up + first 60 min of ny_am only; ny_am 10:30-11:30 NOT covered)
A.price_scale: fixed-point 1e-9 (2 decimal-scaled anomaly files, see scale_anomalies)

B.window_desc: 08:00-09:59 Europe/London (first 2h of the London cash session)

C.window_desc: same window as family A; dates 2026-02..2026-07, beyond OHLCV span — forward archive only, no P-TABLE rows derivable

cross_extraction_overlap: Families A and B share 115 in-span DATES but ZERO common minutes (disjoint intraday windows). A direct same-minute convention check is impossible; Gate 3 runs each family against the same-minute front-month OHLCV bar as the shared reference. MISS recorded: future extractions MUST preserve a deliberate same-minute overlap. The live forward recorder must capture trade prints AND a window overlapping both families.
scale_anomalies_note: The three files previously flagged as decimal-scaled in families A/C are fixed-point 1e-9 magnitudes serialized WITH a decimal point; a string-shape detector misreads them (Gate 3 catch). Scale detection is therefore by magnitude (value > 1e6 => fixed-point), per value.
